items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Peewee Russell or Benny Goodman or other guys sitting on Park Avenue

ctx.x: Oh, we definitely don't. No doubt about it.

... Peewee Russell or Benny Goodman or other guys sitting on Park Avenue, I feel that every-thing that Jack Teagarden got, he should have got double That's exactly how I feel about it. You know the system we are black in the white land so that says it all as far as what we've got and what we have not got and all of the things that have happened to us because it's happened to every one of us.
